app.name: Meeting Organizer
app.description: Midweek meeting assignments, S-89 slips and the S-140

signin.title: Sign in
signin.hero_title: Every part filled, every slip printed.
signin.hero_body: Midweek meeting assignments, S-89 slips and the S-140, in one place.
signin.locked_seconds: Too many wrong passwords. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
signin.locked_minute: Too many wrong passwords. Wait a minute and try again.
signin.unavailable: Sign-in is unavailable right now. Please try again in a moment.
signin.not_set_up: Sign-in isn't set up yet: add APP_PASSWORD to the app's environment variables.

home.no_people_body: Schedules are filled from the people you add, with the parts each one can take.
home.upload_first: Upload the workbook to get each week's parts, then create the first schedule.
home.todo_congregation: Set the congregation name; it heads every schedule sheet
home.todo_workbook: Upload the meeting workbook so weeks get their real parts
home.todo_s89: Upload the blank S-89; slips are printed on it
home.todo_s140: Upload the blank S-140 template for the monthly export
home.todo_no_backup: No backup downloaded yet. The database is the only copy of your schedules.
home.todo_remind: Remind the {count} {people} with a part in the next 7 days

month.title: Month overview
month.sub: Every meeting this month, what is still open, and month-wide printing.
month.create_intro: {count} weeks this month have no schedule. They can be created and filled in one go, then checked week by week. The suggestions follow the same rotation as the Suggest button.
month.is_event: Is one of these an assembly or convention week?
month.created: Created {count} week(s){cleared}. Open each week to check it before printing.
month.gone: Those weeks are no longer in the workbook.

event.already_saved: Already saved that week: {meetings}. Marking the week clears them.
event.clear_them: Clear them (to bring one back later, remove the mark, then use Undo on Create or edit)

sched.title: Create or edit
sched.sub: Pick a date, then fill each part. Only eligible people are listed.
sched.event_week: This week is marked as an assembly or convention week, so there is no midweek meeting to schedule.
sched.event_undo: To schedule it after all, remove the mark under Admin → Settings → Assemblies & conventions. A meeting cleared when the week was marked can then be brought back with Undo on this page.
sched.no_people: Add participants on the Participants page first.
sched.already_saved: A schedule is already saved for this date. It's loaded below, and saving will replace it.
sched.no_workbook_week: No workbook week covers {date}. Check the week dates on the Workbook PDF page, or pick the week yourself below.
sched.workbook_differs: The saved schedule has {saved} numbered part(s), but the workbook week {week} has {count}, or the titles differ. Tick the box below to switch to the workbook parts; names carry over where the part number and role match.
sched.use_workbook: Use parts from the uploaded workbook
sched.gaps: Part number(s) not found in the workbook text: {numbers}. Add them on the Workbook PDF page, under Review and correct a week.
sched.standard_list: Using the standard 8-part list. Upload the workbook PDF to get this week's real part numbers and titles.
sched.unavailable_hint: Away, suspended or inactive. They are left out of the lists below.
sched.suggest_hint: Fills only the empty slots. Anyone already chosen stays, and is not suggested anywhere else.
sched.suggested: Suggestions filled in. Check them, then save.
sched.heading: Heading
sched.gone: {name} is no longer available. Choose someone else.
sched.blocked: Saving is blocked until the red items are fixed.
sched.saved_check: The checks are still worth a look.
sched.not_saved: Not saved: {reason} Correct that part (or the week on the Workbook PDF page) and save again.
sched.undo_confirm: This puts back {what}, replacing what is saved now for the {meeting} on {date}. Undo can itself be undone.
sched.undo_before_delete: the schedule as it was before it was deleted
sched.nothing_to_undo: There is nothing to undo for this meeting.
sched.delete_confirm: The {meeting} on {date} and everyone assigned to it will be removed. Undo on this page can bring it back.
sched.deleted: Schedule deleted. Undo on this page can bring it back.

check.student_and_assistant: {name} is both student and assistant on “{part}”.
check.mixed: “{part}”: student and assistant are in different categories and not family.
check.too_soon: {name} had “{part}” {when} ({date}) — someone else would usually take it this week.
check.whole_number: “{part}”: the {field} should be a whole number, but it is {value}.

print.title: Slips and printing
print.sub: Slips, schedule sheets, the S-140, the CSV and monthly messages, for one meeting or a whole month.
print.none_yet: No schedules have been created yet.
print.no_slips: No student parts are assigned, so there are no slips to print.
print.no_s89: No blank S-89 has been uploaded for {language}. Add one under Admin → Official S-89 blank.
print.slip_rooms: {main} main hall and {aux} auxiliary classroom slip(s); each has its room ticked.
print.s140_need_midweek: Save a midweek schedule to fill the S-140.
print.no_s140: No {language} S-140 template. Upload the blank .docx under Admin.
print.s140_nothing: Nothing to fill for that month (each week needs 3 Treasures parts and a Bible Study).
print.copied: Copied. Paste it into a WhatsApp chat.
print.cant_copy: This browser can't copy images. Use Download image.
print.share_hint: On a phone: download, then share the picture from your gallery to WhatsApp. On a computer: copy, then paste it straight into a WhatsApp chat.
print.weekly_hint: Pick a week: every part in its midweek meeting on one card to share on WhatsApp. A part with nobody yet shows —.
print.person_month_hint: Everything one person has in a month, parts and assisting, on a card of their own.
print.nobody: Nobody from the participants list has an assignment that month.

rem.title: Reminders
rem.sub: Everyone with a part coming up, with a ready WhatsApp message and a calendar link for their phone.
rem.none: No one has a part in the next {days} days.
rem.cant_copy: Couldn't copy here. Long-press to select the text instead.
rem.cal_help: Each person's Calendar link is a feed of all their parts. Once subscribed, new and changed parts appear by themselves, with an alert the evening before. On Android, add the Calendar link in Google Calendar under "From URL". On an iPhone, send the iPhone link instead: tapping it offers "Subscribe" (the plain link only adds the parts once). Set the meeting times so entries have the right hours; without them they show as all-day.
rem.times_saved: Saved. Calendars pick up the new times the next time they refresh.
rem.msg_intro_one: A reminder of your assignment at {congregation}:
rem.msg_intro_many: A reminder of your assignments at {congregation}:
rem.msg_thanks: Thank you, and please let us know quickly if you can't make it.

people.title: Participants
people.sub: Who can take which parts, families, away dates and suspensions.
people.group_hint: Leave empty for an adult publisher.
people.added_dup: There was already someone called {name}; added anyway.
people.saved: Saved. Existing schedules show the updated name.
people.reassign: Already scheduled in this period; reassign these:
people.pick_days: Pick the first and last day.
people.too_long: That period is over a year long.
people.in_use: {name} appears in {count} saved assignment(s). Untick Active instead so the history stays intact.
people.delete_confirm: {name} will be removed for good. They have no saved assignments, so no schedule changes.
people.has_history: This person has saved assignments. Untick Active instead so the history stays intact.
people.not_found: That record wasn't found. Reload the page and try again.

wb.title: Workbook PDF
wb.sub: Upload the meeting workbook so each week gets its real parts.
wb.intro: Upload the Life and Ministry Meeting Workbook PDF. Numbered parts with their minutes are read for each week, and you can correct them below.
wb.in_use: Workbook in use: {file} ({count} week(s)). Uploading another replaces it.
wb.from_current_hint: Weeks that finished before today are left out. Untick to keep the whole workbook, for example to fill in a week you missed.
wb.remove_confirm: Remove the workbook? Schedules will use the standard part list until another workbook is uploaded. Saved schedules are not changed.
wb.no_parts_at_all: No numbered parts with durations were found. The PDF may be scanned, or laid out differently. Schedules will use the standard part list.
wb.dropped: {count} week(s) already finished and were left out: {weeks}
wb.garbled: The text in this PDF could not be read properly: {count} part title(s) came out garbled, so part numbers may be missing too. This is a problem with the file's fonts, not its contents. Example: {example}
wb.guessed_roles: {count} field-ministry part(s) didn't match a known part type, so they default to Initial Presentation. Only people with that privilege will be offered for them. Set the Role below if that's wrong: {parts}
wb.not_english: The week headings aren't in English, so sections are guessed from part numbers and durations. Check them below.
wb.dates_guessed: The week dates were guessed. Check the first week below; every other week follows from it.
wb.first_week_hint: The Monday of the first week in the workbook.
wb.unnamed: The date line above these weeks wasn't recognised, so they are numbered instead: {weeks}. The parts are still right; rename them below so the S-140 shows the real heading.
wb.missing_numbers: Some weeks have missing part numbers. Open the week below, compare with the workbook text, and add the missing rows.
wb.heading: Week heading
wb.heading_hint: Shown on the S-140 and in the week lists.
wb.heading_taken: There is already a week called {name}.
wb.week_gone: That week is no longer in the workbook.
wb.week_saved: Saved. Use Create or edit to assign this week.
wb.rows_left_out: Rows without a title, section or role are left out when saving.

rep.title: Reports
rep.sub: How often each person had a part, to spot anyone left out.
rep.future: Include assignments already planned after today
rep.left_out: {count} person(s) had no assignment in this period: {names}

admin.title: Admin
admin.sub: Blank forms, backups, settings and the change log.
admin.s89_hint: Upload the fillable blank S-89 for each slip language and the app prints on the real form, with its exact wording. Without one it draws its own slip.
admin.s140_hint: Upload the blank once per language and the Printing page uses it every month. It is a .docx, not a PDF, and the published blank holds one week; the app repeats it for the month.
admin.backup_hint: Includes participants, schedules, away dates, suspensions, the workbook, settings and the change log.
admin.restore_sure: I understand this replaces all current data
admin.not_backup: This isn't a Meeting Organizer backup.
admin.congregation_hint: Printed at the top of every schedule sheet. The slip and schedule language is chosen in the sidebar.
admin.aux_default: Auxiliary classroom in use (the default for new midweek schedules; any week can still differ)
admin.convert: Convert 3 ) N to ɛ ɔ ŋ when saving names (turn off if a name genuinely contains 3, ) or a capital N)
admin.days_hint: Used to place workbook weeks on the right day of the week.
admin.rotation_days: Days before someone may take the same part again
admin.rotation_hint: Suggest and the red "too soon" marker use this many days since someone's last turn at a part. The rest of the colour-coding doesn't change; this only moves where the red/green line falls.
admin.rotation_range: Use a number from 1 to 90 (the default is {default}).
admin.events_hint: A week with a circuit assembly or a convention has no midweek meeting. Marked here, it shows its own label everywhere that week appears, and is never offered as a schedule to create.
admin.language_saved: Slips and printouts will be in {language}.
admin.your_name_hint: Used for the greeting on the Home page.

err.page_body: Nothing you saved is lost. The database may have been slow to wake up; trying again usually fixes it.
err.global_body: Nothing you saved is lost. Please try again in a moment.
err.not_found_body: That address isn't part of the Meeting Organizer.
err.not_saved: That didn't save. Please try again; if it keeps happening, the database may be unreachable.
err.timeout: The server took too long to answer. Please try again; if it keeps happening, the database may be unreachable.
err.no_answer: The server didn't answer ({code}). Please try again.
err.unreachable: Couldn't reach the server. Check the connection and try again.
err.too_big: The upload didn't get through. Files over about 4 MB are too big for the server.
err.cal_bad_link: This calendar link doesn't work. Ask for a new one.
err.cal_unreadable: Couldn't read the schedule just now.
err.s89_fields: Expected the S-89's form fields; found {count}. Upload the fillable blank form, not a scan or a printout.
err.s89_unreadable: This file couldn't be read as the fillable S-89 blank form: {reason}
err.no_font: No font with ɛ, ɔ and ŋ was found for the slips.
err.s140_word: This file could not be read as a Word document: {reason}
err.s140_no_table: The template has no table - is this the blank S-140?
err.s140_no_date: No date row found — this does not look like the blank S-140. It should contain [DATE].
err.s140_blocks: The template has {blocks} week block(s) but {weeks} weeks were selected.
